prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line plate for the heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is LINE STYLE ONLY, the Vairocana contour master. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. No fills, shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, grain, paper texture, gradients, halos or checkerboards. Door recesses are outlines, not black blocks. Show the selected subject complete and centered with 8% margins, verticals vertical and minimal perspective; photograph fixes identity and proportions. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, clutter and sky. No letters, calligraphy, labels, captions, border or watermark. HUGUANG guild hall YUWANG GONG gate, not Guangdong hall: exactly THREE arched doorways, center taller, symmetrical wavy curved fire-wall crown, central sculpted seated figure and cloud reliefs. Draw complete central gate only; no neighboring shops. Blank plaques. Landscape 1536x1024, building about 82% width.
